1. (Currently Amended) A method of cementing comprising: providing a cement composition comprising a carboxylated inulin and at least one additional component selected from the group consisting of borate salts, an organic acid comprising an alpha-hydroxycarboxylic acid, a synthetic polymer comprising a carboxylate group, or any combination thereof; and allowing the cement composition to set.

2. (Currently Amended) The method of claim 1 wherein the cement composition has a thickening time of from about 2 hours to about 11 hours at temperatures up to about 280 *F.

3. (Currently Amended) The method of claim 1 wherein a viscosity of the cement composition is about constant for a period of time after the cement composition is placed.

4. (Currently Amended) The method of claim 1 wherein a suspension aid is not added to the cement composition.

5. (Currently Amended) The method of claim 1 wherein the cement composition has a free water separation of from about 0.0 to about 2 wt.% of the cement composition.

6. (Currently Amended) The method of claim 1 wherein the carboxylated inulin is derived from an inulin having an average molecular weight of about 500 or higher.

7. (Currently Amended) The method of claim 1 wherein the carboxylated inulin comprises carboxymethylated inulin.

8. (Currently Amended) The method of claim 7 wherein the carboxymethylated inulin has a degree of substitution by carboxymethylated of from about 0.1 to about 0.3.

9. (Currently Amended) The method of claim 1 wherein the cement composition comprises from about 0.1 to about 5 wt. % of carboxylated inulin.

10. (Currently Amended) The method of claim 1 wherein the cement composition is placed in a subterranean formation.

11. (Currently Amended) The method of claim 1 wherein the cement composition is placed in a wellbore.
